fraction_schedule.month_note: Multi-bin trips run year-round for both fractions; monthly totals range 256-320 trips (Glass never appears as a multi-bin trip in trips.json). No seasonal on/off pattern: packaging and paper/card are each collected in every month of the year.
fraction_schedule.purity_note: Trips are fraction-pure: 59630/59646 stops (99.97%) match the trip's declared fraction; only 16 stops in 7 trips mix codes. Packaging and paper/card run on the SAME days, not alternating: of 1200 days with multi-bin trips, 818 days (68.2%) have both fractions, 226 packaging-only, 156 paper/card-only.

two_bin_logic.conclusion: Trips logging <=2 bins but lasting >=5 h have median 7.41 h / 122.0 km, nearly identical to trips with >=15 logged bins (8.09 h / 175.0 km), so the trip identifier spans a full shift and bin recording is partial - only some services were logged.

category_rule: Applied in order: U (insufficient) = <5 collection events. H (high need) = share of pre-emptying driver readings >=75 is >=80%, OR sensor fill rate >=13 units/day (median of positive day-over-day deltas of daily-median valid readings; ~13/day fills the ~84-unit ceiling in under a week). L (low need) = share of pre-emptying readings <=25 is >=25%, OR rarely collected (<0.5 events/month over the bin's own observation span). M (moderate) = rest. Thresholds are anchored at the empirical upper quartile/decile because the driver scale is skewed high (median bin: 67% of emptyings read >=75; median sensor fill rate 10 units/day), so the naive 40%/fast-fill rule would label 73% of bins high. pfull/plow are computed over events with a valid pre-emptying reading (previous non-event reading of the same container <=15 min before the collection-event row, value >=0).
